newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: U.S. pilots missing off Korea presumed dead.
newsitem.headline: U.S. pilots missing off Korea presumed dead.

text.p: A joint U.S.-South Korean search team has given up hope of rescuing two U.S. Air Force officers whose fighter jet plunged into waters off South Korea's west coast on Sunday, a U.S. military spokesman said on Tuesday.

"No one could have survived in that cold water for a day and a half," Jim Coles told Reuters. "It's changed from a search and rescue operation to a salvage and recovery of remains operation this morning."
Two F/A-18 jets from the U.S. base in Iwakuni, Japan, were on a training mission when one aircraft went down. The second jet returned to Japan on Sunday, Coles said.
The officers presumed dead were identified as Captain Mark R. Nickles, 29, from Mesa, Arizona, and Major Danny A. D'Eredita, 38, from Syracuse, New York.
The cause of the crash is still being investigated, Coles said.
